shared: One runtime shared by your games.
dll_notice: Requires Lossless.dll from the public Steam release of Lossless Scaling. The DLL is not included.
remove_confirm: Remove this runtime? Game profiles and your DLL will be preserved.
live_hint: Pause or resume frame generation in this session.
adaptive_hint: Adjusts generated frames to reach the target FPS.
multiplier_hint: Fixed multiplier, or maximum when adaptive output is enabled.
flow_hint: Lower values reduce GPU cost and motion detail.
performance_hint: Reduces processing cost with a quality trade-off.
cap_hint: Before generation. Zero disables the cap.
threshold_hint: Stops generating frames above this rate. Zero disables it.
startup: Applies the next time you start the game.
description: Generate frames from the game image. Settings are saved for this game only.
next_launch: Uses the selected runtime and your Lossless Scaling DLL.
install_first: Download the component under Manage before enabling it.
exclusive: Enabling MAKO disables the other frame generator for this game.
conflicts: Check HDR, advanced latency and Vulkan capture options. They must be disabled for this integration.
version_hint: You can select a previously installed compatible version.
compatibility: Use one frame generator at a time. Disable in-game frame generation. Requires Vulkan; compatibility depends on the game.
how_text: Prepare the runtime, select Lossless.dll, and enable MAKO for this game. For Steam or another launcher, use the PeliRun command below. Removing the add-on bypasses generation while preserving the game and its tuning files.
running: The game is running. Only reloadable adjustments can be changed.
overview_hint: Saved profile configuration; does not confirm the effect is running.
bridge_missing: This host cannot save game launch integrations.
prepare_first: Enable MAKO before starting the game.
remove_all_confirm: Remove all downloaded MAKO runtimes? Profiles, game files and your DLL will be preserved.
